## A live D3 plot

The chart below is created in the browser from the readable source in this
slide. GitHub Pages only needs to serve the generated static files.

::: {.chart-frame}
```{ojs}
chart = {
  const d3 = await require("d3@7.9.0");
  const data = [
    {topic: "DOM", value: 32},
    {topic: "Bind", value: 68},
    {topic: "Scale", value: 51},
    {topic: "Draw", value: 82}
  ];

  const width = 1040;
  const height = 430;
  const margin = {top: 24, right: 30, bottom: 66, left: 72};
  const x = d3.scaleBand()
    .domain(data.map(d => d.topic))
    .range([margin.left, width - margin.right])
    .padding(0.28);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear()
    .domain([0, d3.max(data, d => d.value)])
    .nice()
    .range([height - margin.bottom, margin.top]);

  const svg = d3.create("svg")
    .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
    .attr("role", "img")
    .attr(
      "aria-label",
      "D3 bar chart: DOM 32, Bind 68, Scale 51, and Draw 82"
    );

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - margin.bottom})`)
    .call(d3.axisBottom(x).tickSizeOuter(0))
    .call(g => g.select(".domain").attr("stroke", "#526871"));

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("transform", `translate(${margin.left},0)`)
    .call(d3.axisLeft(y).ticks(4).tickSize(-(width - margin.left - margin.right)))
    .call(g => g.select(".domain").remove())
    .call(g => g.selectAll(".tick line").attr("stroke", "#dce6ea"));

  svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("rect")
    .data(data)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("x", d => x(d.topic))
      .attr("y", d => y(d.value))
      .attr("width", x.bandwidth())
      .attr("height", d => y(0) - y(d.value))
      .attr("rx", 5)
      .attr("fill", (d, i) => i === data.length - 1 ? "#b84a2b" : "#087f8c");

  svg.selectAll("text")
    .attr("fill", "#172a33")
    .style("font-family", "Avenir Next, Segoe UI, sans-serif")
    .style("font-size", "20px");

  return svg.node();
}
```
:::
